plan_version: <integer, bumped on every edit or re-plan>

spec.spec_version: <integer, must match the spec file's version>

approval.at: <datetime, written by the gate page on approve>
approval.plan_hash: <hash of this file minus this block; dispatch and assembly verify it>

interfaces.id: I<n>, carried over from the spec's interface ids where one exists
interfaces.spec_ref: <I<n> in the spec, or null for a seam the plan introduced>
interfaces.name: <type / function / route / schema name as it appears in code>
interfaces.kind: <type | function | schema | route | migration | file-format | event>
interfaces.path: <file that carries the seam; joins the protected set at interface-gate approval>
interfaces.check: <contract check name from the test map>
interfaces.stub: <true when declared with a not-implemented body for a unit to finish; false when the declaration is complete in itself>

units.id: U<n>, stable, never reused or renumbered
units.name: <short human name>
spec_refs: <B<n> and E<n> ids this unit is accountable for; references only, never copied text>
owns: <paths this unit may write; its diff boundary; no path in two units>
produces: <I<n> stubbed interfaces whose bodies this unit implements>
checks: <check names that must be green; always includes contract checks of needs and produces; later waves also include earlier waves' behaviour checks>
units.group: <parallel group; units sharing a group run concurrently>
decisions: <every call made where the spec was silent, one sentence each; presence requires the human-decision flag>

ceilings.iterations: <max attempts against this unit's checks before returning failed; defaults from kickoff when absent>

order: <wave 2, starts only when wave 1 has landed>
